ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35:1 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) ratio across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the left leading edge; the central and inner portions of the fluke consist of a contiguous low-intensity dark gray to black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; the vertex depth is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; a notable secondary indentation or chip-like defect is visible on the right lobe approximately two-thirds from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to convex at the outer margins, resulting in tapered, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels at the distal tips, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible on the dark pigmentation of the right lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the lobe axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss at the distal tips; visible notch-like indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion at the base of the fluke caused by high-intensity white water spray and surface cavitation.
